meta.title: Axis counts read off the plates by the operator
meta.why: Independent of the automated measuring pass that produced bay_pitch in daly_measurements.json. Where the two disagree, prefer this: it is a count of things visible on the drawing, not a scale-bar inference.
meta.definition: axes = vertical compositional divisions across the facade, INCLUDING the entrance axis.

ce119.verdict: DISPUTED — our facade_width is 14.93 m, the operator reads 12.4 m. A 2.5 m disagreement. Our figure is the widest pitch in the corpus and currently anchors _BAY_PITCH_MAX, so resolve this before relying on it.

what_this_constrains: Interpolating the four points brackets a 14.0 m frontage (House A) between 12.4 m -> 4 axes and 15.0 m -> 5 axes, so it should carry 5. It currently carries 4. See dev/logs/a24-wip/README.md.
